title: South Milwaukee Performing Arts Center

services.name: Facility & Rentals
services.desc: Your guests park in lot off Oak Creek Pkwy located on NorthWest side of the school and enter door #9. Driveway located off east side of 15th Ave. to the loading dock door #3 for load ins which leads to the scene shop and backstage. South Milwaukee Performing Arts Center is the venue of choice for dozens of performing arts organizations, presenters, dance studios, businesses and groups. SMPAC is capable of presenting the finest performances from the local community to the world stage. SMPAC features a partial-thrust proscenium style stage. blurb: South Milwaukee Performing Arts Center (SMPAC) is a professionally-managed non-profit. We serve the School District of South Milwaukee, its students, community organizations and professional presenters. We are the host venue of choice for arts groups, presenters, dance studios and more.
